core.derivation: Open zero-frequency core Green kernel has pointwise norm<=2, hence inverse L2 norm<=2L; incoming and adjoint response energy<=2L. Accretivity gives ||P_n(k)-P_n(0)||<=k*(8L^2 sup(m f)+4L).
core.zero_scope: The chiral zero has P(0)=0 and exact ||P(k)||=2k I_f exp(-kL); it is added separately.

tail_green_control.free_radial_normalization: C=n/r gives E0(R)=2R/(2n-1), including both radial characteristics.
